title: HREF: HUMAN RESPONSE-GUIDED EVALUATION OF INSTRUCTION FOLLOWING IN LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the 'length bias rate' by calculating the difference between a judge model's frequency of preferring longer responses versus its frequency of preferring shorter responses.

Prompting judge models to directly compare model-generated responses against human-written responses to observe if models disproportionately favor the stylistic characteristics of model-generated text.
